title: The town that's been burning since 1962 🔥
subject: fire
description:
Would you visit a town that's still on fire? 👇

Centralia, Pennsylvania has had a coal mine fire burning under it since 1962. It turned a mining town into a near ghost town.

Sources: Pennsylvania DEP ("Centralia Mine Fire Resources"), History.com ("This Mine Fire Has Been Burning for More Than 50 Years")

scenes.text: In 1981, the ground opened under a 12-year-old boy.
Todd Domboski barely made it out. The hole was steaming.
This was Centralia, Pennsylvania, and the town was burning underground.
In May 1962, trash burned in an old mining pit, and the fire spread into the coal mines below.
But here's the strange part. It never went out. Congress spent over $42 million moving people away.
